name: Logo per language
description: Provide new logo config for each installed language.
project_description:
The "Logo per language" module allows administrators to set different Drupal logos based on the active language of their website. This module extends the default logo functionality provided by Drupal core, providing a convenient way to customize the site logo for each language.

 Back to top 

 Features: 
 
 Assign unique logos for each language on your Drupal site. 
 Seamlessly integrates with the theme settings page for easy logo management. 
 Retains all the functionality of the Drupal default logo settings. 
 
 Back to top 

 How to Use: 
 
To use the "Logo per language" module, follow these steps:

 
 Navigate to the theme settings page in your Drupal administration interface. 
 Edit the logo for each language by selecting the desired image file. 
 Save the settings to apply the language-specific logos to your site. 
 
 
With the "Logo per language" module, you can now effortlessly customize the appearance of your Drupal site by assigning unique logos for each language.
